coverage.cycle: The general table is undated. Only the three named English programmes below have separately verified 2027 guides.
limits: The 24 routes comprise 11 divisions, 10 colleges and 3 named programmes. A listed major or track is not necessarily a separately selectable application programme.
The 78 source cells can combine majors or tracks, and names can recur across routes. One additional open-choice statement is not an enumerated list of degrees.
Teaching language is unconfirmed for the general division and college entries. A section labelled Chinese and English programmes does not make every major English-taught.
The tables can change before enrolment. Separate routes, including the THU–CUHK dual degree, may sit outside this catalogue.

coverage.cycle: 2027 catalogue snapshot. A catalogue listing does not confirm that applications are currently open.
limits: All 40 departments that returned records in the checked international master’s catalogue are represented. This is coverage of that source, not every degree or international route at Tsinghua.
Each entry is a department plus degree code. The 215 research fields are nested choices, not 215 additional degrees.
42 fields carry an explicit English-medium label. Other languages are shown only where confirmed; missing labels do not establish Chinese-only teaching.
Separately advertised programmes can have their own application systems. Confirm deadlines, eligibility, fees, scholarships and supervisor requirements in the current programme notice.

coverage.cycle: Prior-cycle reference: 2026. A 2027 central undergraduate table has not been verified. Do not carry 2026 requirements or dates forward.
limits: The checked table contains 23 departments, 27 admissions group labels and 104 specialisation-option rows. Specialisations are not separate verified admissions openings.
Yuanpei’s university-wide choice statement is preserved separately. It does not enumerate every eligible degree.
Medical admissions use separate instructions and are not included here. This page covers the checked main-campus international route only.
This is the verified 2026 table. Use a new central notice to confirm the next intake before making an application plan.

coverage.cycle: Prior-cycle reference: 2026. A 2027 central catalogue has not been verified. Individual 2027 programme notices do not update this whole list.
limits: 177 entries come from the Chinese-taught catalogue and 43 from the English-taught catalogue. There are 189 distinct department–degree-code pairs; a pair listed in both languages appears twice.

36 of 37 linked Chinese-catalogue PDFs and all 12 English-catalogue PDFs were retrieved. The 49th linked PDF, for 先进制造与机器人学院 (Advanced Manufacturing and Robotics), returned 404. No entries were inferred for that missing source.
